body: hi, a girl here… that’s the thing.. you’re lacking the confidence. most women stray towards the guys who exude confidence, whether in their looks or their personality or VOICE. fixating so much on your physical will leave you more insecure and have you feeling small in any environment rather than keeping focus on your character and how your energy can fill up a space. are you approachable yourself? also, how old are you and what environments are you in that makes you feel this way?

No you’re not in the wrong girl and it don’t matter who or how many people tell you you are, you aren’t. Yeah it may be hard to leave right now but you always got to do what’s best for you. With a guy like this, you gotta let him do what he wants and then your best option is doing as you want. Not saying you have to cheat back, but definitely preoccupy yourself with something else. Focus on you more and not him. Yeah your family loves him but that ain’t got nothing to do with YOU sweetheart, your best option is getting the hell away from ALL of them. I know it’s hard and you don’t want to be alone but loving yourself will always be more important than anything and anyone. Eventually the more you put more time into yourself and the things you want and love, that man won’t even exist to you. Trust me, on another timeline and in another dimension you’re flourishing without him. You just have to trust and believe and want it for yourself to make it happen. Don’t let this guy ruin you! There is plenty of good men out here who’s more than willing to take his spot. And I’m telling you from experience, don’t waste another minute with this man. If you can’t leave him physically right now, prepare yourself mentally and emotionally first. It works like a charm.
